items.description: Sierra de Juárez is a mountain range in Baja California, known for its arid landscapes and pine forests at higher elevations.
The Gulf Coastal Plain is a vast, low-lying region along Mexico's Gulf Coast, characterized by wetlands and rich agricultural lands.
The Yucatán Peninsula is a large landmass separating the Caribbean Sea from the Gulf of Mexico, known for its flat topography and cenotes.
The Tabasco Plain is a lowland region in southeastern Mexico, known for its extensive wetlands, rivers, and petroleum reserves.
Sierra Madre de Sonora is part of the Sierra Madre Occidental, featuring deep canyons and forested mountains.
Sierra de Puebla is a mountain range in eastern Puebla, known for its lush vegetation, cloud forests, and waterfalls.
Sierra de las Minas, although primarily in Guatemala, is noted for its high biodiversity and cloud forests, impacting regional relief.
